items.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
items.description: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

items.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
items.description: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

items.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
items.description: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

items.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
items.description: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

items.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
items.description: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.

items.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
items.description: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

items.title: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
items.description: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.
